{{vginfobox |gameid = {{gameid|id=BLES00229, BLUS30127, NPEB00882, NPUB30702|oid=BLES00258, BLJM60093|ird=Yes}}
'''''The Complete Edition'''''
{{gameid|id=BLES01128, BLUS30682|oid=BLJM60346|ird=Yes}} }} ==Configuration== {{config |spu xfloat accuracy = Accurate |spu xfloat accuracy notes = Fixes missing collision. Requires SPU LLVM recompiler. Expect audio stutter. |anti-aliasing = Disabled |anti-aliasing notes = When enabled, outlines seen on characters and objects under shadows and water will be visible. Additionally, buildings in the distance are not rendered correctly. |zcull accuracy = Relaxed |zcull accuracy notes = Improves performance without any noticeable issues. |resolution scale threshold = 320x320 |resolution scale threshold notes = Properly scales bloom when using Resolution Scaling. |write color buffers = On |write color buffers notes = Fixes missing reflections. |multithreaded rsx = On |multithreaded rsx notes = Improves performance. |asynchronous texture streaming = On |asynchronous texture streaming notes = If you have a stronger GPU, this can give substantial performance boost. |spu block size = Mega |spu block size notes = Improves performance. |rsx fifo accuracy notes = Helps to reduce crashes. }}

{{vginfobox |gameid = {{gameid|id=BLES00932, BLUS30443, BCJS30022, NPEB01202, NPUB30910, NPJA00102|oid=BCAS20071|ird=Yes}}
'''''Trade Demo'''''
{{gameid|id=BLUD80018|ird=Yes}} }} Demon's Souls runs well. ==Configuration== {{config |spu block size = Safe |spu block size notes = Mega and Giga are unstable with Demon's Souls at the moment. |resolution scale threshold = 640 x 640 |resolution scale threshold notes = Properly scales the depth of field effect at resolution scales higher than the default 1280x720. |write color buffers = On |write color buffers notes = Fixes missing graphics ingame. |maximum spurs threads = 3 |maximum spurs threads notes = Helps with performance. Don’t mess with this if you have a CPU with more than 6 cores and 12 threads as you may experience performance loss. |highly recommended patch = Unlock FPS |highly recommended patch notes = Can make certain shortcuts/skips more difficult to do. |recommended patch = Skip Intro Videos, Disable Motion Blur }}
